FN-HJJC68-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 3
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Rep.
Security Hollis
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/24/2023
House Bill 3 as introduced could increase receipts to the
State General Fund from fines; and could increase the
obligations of the district attorneys by an undetermined
amount dependent upon the number of persons charged with and
convicted of the offense provided by this bill.
Page 1
